description: Elections Commission - Order under Section 38(3) of the (Local Authority Election Ordinance) Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with electoral processes, specifically the postponement and rescheduling of local authority elections in the Ratnapura district due to funding issues. It references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, notifications for nominations, and the declaration of poll dates, which directly falls under election-related matters as defined in Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
